app.name: Unauth Fraud Intelligence
app.short_description: Identity confidence and claims context on every Zendesk ticket.
app.long_description: Shows Unauth store checks, network context, and case reports in the ticket sidebar using your Unauth API key.
app.installation_instructions: Upload this private app, enter your Unauth API key from Settings → API & Integrations in the Unauth dashboard, then install to the ticket sidebar.

api_key.label: Unauth API key
api_key.helpText: Create an API key in Unauth under Settings → Integrations → Advanced (API keys).
